objective: Make the Pi extension and specialist launcher work on native Windows: call the bundled CLI through Bun on scripts/holyagent.js instead of `sh scripts/holyagent`, and treat Pi's powershell tool like bash wherever the tool selection or gates name bash.
scope: Worktree: /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-win (branch release/0.3.0/fix/pi-windows-launch, from the top of the open 0.3.0 stack). Work and run every command there.

Today packages/integrations/pi/src/extension.ts:681-682 runs exec(signal, "sh", [wrapper, PI_PROJECT_FLAG, project, ...args]) on every platform, and wrapperPath (extension.ts:551-559) returns scripts/holyagent. generate.ts:132-159 already ships scripts/holyagent.js, and packages/integrations/pi/tests/session-context.test.ts:184 shows the Bun-direct pattern. Read the generated sh wrapper first and keep every flag it passes Bun (for example --no-env-file and the empty bunfig --config), so the direct call behaves the same. Choose whether to call Bun directly on every platform or only on win32 from what is simpler and keeps one tested path; say which and why.

Pi's built-in tool list on Windows includes powershell beside bash. Find every place in packages/runtime/src/pi (tools.ts selections, specialist tool lists) and packages/integrations/pi/src (gates, tool_call handling) that names bash, and make powershell get the same treatment where Pi offers it, so a Windows root or specialist is not left without a shell or with an ungated one.

Check how the specialist launcher spawns child pi processes and resolves paths on win32 (a pi.cmd shim, backslash paths, quoting) and fix what would fail there; cover it with tests that stub the platform as extension.test.ts:484 and :1261-1353 already do.

Update the tests that lock in the sh call (extension.test.ts:1264-1273 and nearby, pi.test.ts:184-237) to the new behavior, and update docs/pi/orchestration.md:78-81 and docs/pi/t3-code.md:177-181 where they describe this as only decided.
